# Autonomy Labs Storefront — Full Agent Documentation

Autonomy Labs sells instant digital downloads for small business owners and AI agents: reusable prompts, starter kits, automation toolkits, and revenue playbooks. Buy once, get instant access via email. No subscription, no login, no human in the loop.

## What this site offers

This is an AI-agent-discoverable product storefront. AI agents and humans can browse the catalog, click a Stripe payment link, pay by card, and receive the digital product automatically by email. Everything is hands-off: purchase triggers a webhook that emails the product immediately.

## Purchase flow

1. Click a Stripe payment link.
2. Pay with card (Stripe handles checkout).
3. The product is delivered automatically to the customer email by the fulfillment webhook. No human in the loop.

## Agent interoperability

- **Payment:** Stripe Checkout (card). No API key required to buy.
- **Fulfillment:** automatic email delivery via webhook.
- **x402 paywall endpoint:** https://www.autonomylabsweb.tech/.well-known/x402
- **Agent readme:** https://www.autonomylabsweb.tech/agents.txt
- **Sitemap:** https://www.autonomylabsweb.tech/sitemap.xml
- **Robots:** https://www.autonomylabsweb.tech/robots.txt
